source: Quran.com API v4 text_uthmani (all 114 chapters, 6,236 ayahs) — the same canonical text the reader serves.
method: Derived from the canonical text: two ayahs are similar only when they share verbatim phrases (a shared 4-word phrase, or 2+ shared 3-word phrases), weighted by phrase rarity. No hand-written pairs, no text search relabelled as similarity.
